mutation.description: Replace the producer adapter count while leaving all three adapter statuses unchanged.
Promote an incomplete adapter result to a structural success terminal without evidence.
Point the candidate artifact reference at a material path that is absent from the pinned root.
Replace the result fingerprint after all result fields have otherwise remained unchanged.
Replace the fixed nine-slot PASS projection with a count that cannot be recounted.
Change the replay terminal while the fixed slot observations still all describe verification.
Mark the producer process as failed so a Proof cannot be promoted to a closed replay result.
Replace the replay result fingerprint after the nine slot content has been materialized.
Delete the caller-owned replay result so the Harness cannot manufacture a TEST_REPORT.
Add a class under the protected test-kit namespace to the candidate provider archive.
Replace the candidate bytes after the Challenge Pin has been bound to the original artifact.
Replace a file inside the sealed Admission Evidence Root after its tree commitment was recorded.
Point the observed Harness code source at a byte-equal but inode-distinct alias artifact.
Replace the Ed25519 signature bytes while retaining the signed review claims and policy.
Under-report the open P0 finding in every signed count projection and re-sign the altered claims.
Replace the rollback instruction bytes after Admission bound the original instruction fingerprint.
Set one catalog Guard outcome to FAIL while leaving the projected conclusion at PASS.
Replace the A2 result fingerprint after the complete admission document has been materialized.
Replace the candidate artifact digest while keeping the URI inside the caller-pinned root.
Point the Proof Envelope at a missing result URI instead of its canonical replay result material.
Replace the envelope result raw digest while preserving the result URI and JSON schema.
Replace the envelope transcript raw digest while preserving the actual process transcript bytes.
Replace the sealed producer material tree digest after all referenced files are closed.
Map the completed zero-exit transcript to INVALID with exit two in the outer Proof Envelope.
Set a non-Guard required slot to FAIL while the stored A2 conclusion remains PASS.
Create a signed review whose FINDING check has no corresponding finding record.
Create a signed review with duplicate finding identifiers that cannot be uniquely audited.
Create a signed review whose finding identifiers are valid but not in canonical order.
Replace the envelope keyId with an unknown key instead of resolving an exact policy key.
Replace the envelope issuer with an issuer absent from the policy and revocation snapshot.
Replace the envelope authority with an authority not allowed by the trust policy.
Replace the envelope revocation snapshot digest without changing the signed review body.
Replace the reviewer policy fingerprint while retaining the fixture key and algorithm.
Create one valid open P1 finding, under-report its signed openP1 projection, and re-sign with the authorized fixture signer.
Create one valid skipped review check, under-report its signed skippedCount projection, and re-sign with the authorized fixture signer.
Re-sign an envelope whose candidate fingerprint no longer equals the policy subject.
Re-sign a body with a reviewedAt value different from the envelope reviewedAt.
Re-sign a review against a revocation snapshot issued after the review time.
